title: Scalable Robust MCTS with Anytime Deterministic Optimality Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2610.15461v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: MDP planners often rely on nominal transition models that may differ from the true dynamics. Robust MDP planning accounts for this uncertainty through a set of admissible models, but doing so with limited online computation is challenging: the search tree grows exponentially with the horizon and each robust backup requires an additional optimization. Existing online robust methods remain limited in scale and offer at most probabilistic guarantees. We introduce, to the best of our knowledge, the first deterministic anytime guarantees for robust online MDP planning. We restrict computation to the sampled search tree while deterministically bounding the contribution of unsampled trajectories. For any fixed policy, we derive lower and upper bounds on the gap between its projected and true robust values under rectangular and non-rectangular uncertainty sets. translated_abstract: MDP规划器通常依赖于可能与真实动力学不同的名义转移模型。鲁棒MDP规划通过一组可容许模型来考虑这种不确定性，但在有限的在线计算条件下做到这一点极具挑战性：搜索树随视界呈指数级增长，且每次鲁棒回传都需要额外的优化。现有的在线鲁棒方法规模受限，且最多只能提供概率性保证。据我们所知，我们首次为鲁棒在线MDP规划引入了确定性的任意时刻保证。我们将计算限制在采样的搜索树内，同时对未采样轨迹的贡献进行确定性界定。对于任意固定策略，我们在矩形和非矩形不确定性集下，推导出其预测鲁棒值与真实鲁棒值之间差距的下界和上界。在矩形不确定性下，我们通过鲁棒贝尔曼算子传播这些界
tldr: 本文首次为鲁棒在线MDP规划提供了确定性的任意时刻最优性保证，通过将计算限制在采样搜索树内并确定性界定未采样轨迹的贡献，实现了可扩展的鲁棒MCTS。
